headline: Primary-source semiconductor demand resilient; AI infrastructure funding and momentum remain risks
overall: Price-blind: Microsoft/Meta large published capex plans; TSMC/ASML strong guidance; Micron record memory results; sector F12M EPS revisions unverified. Financing concerns may precede hardware order cuts, but none independently verified. Oct 19 Reuters reported SOXX +3.6% premarket after Oct 16 close $493.39; not a live cash-session quote. Repo technical score 3/7 DEFENSIVE is dated Oct 15 and stale. No demonstrated qualitative forecasting skill without prospective scoring.

factors.name: AI capex
factors.assessment: Constructive plans, funding uncertainty; confidence medium
factors.reason: Jul 29 Microsoft $41bn quarterly capex; Meta 2026 $130-145bn guidance. TrendForce Oct 14 projects nine-cloud 2027 >$1.5tn (forecast, not actual). Hypothesis: well-funded buyers sustain spending, weaker borrowers delay. Bull: monetization; bear: lower ROI. Falsifier: guide cuts or continued funded orders. Missing: comparable baselines/ROI.

factors.name: Semiconductor cycle
factors.assessment: Memory tight, consumer divergence; confidence medium
factors.reason: Micron Sep 30 Q4 $54.23bn revenue. TrendForce Sep 30 projects Q4 DRAM +10-15%, NAND +15-20% QoQ; these are forecasts. Hypothesis: enterprise memory stronger than consumer. Bull: scarcity; bear: inventory. Falsifier: realized price declines/inventory buildup. Missing: contract settlements, shipments.

factors.name: Earnings revisions
factors.assessment: Strong supplier guidance; SOXX revisions not measured; confidence low on revisions
factors.reason: TSMC Oct 15 guided Q4 revenue $52.3-54.3bn; ASML Oct 14 guided Q4 €14.2-15.2bn. These are company plans, not index EPS revisions. Hypothesis: strength concentrated. Bull: broader upgrades; bear: delayed cuts. Falsifier: dated index-weighted F12M consensus changes. Missing: vendor series.

factors.name: Competition
factors.assessment: Custom inference silicon expanding; confidence medium
factors.reason: Microsoft Oct 12 Maia 300 2027 roadmap (efficiency claims unverified). Broadcom Sep 2 reported AI semiconductor revenue $16.7bn, guided $21.7bn. Hypothesis: ASIC adoption grows. Bull: expanding TAM; bear: GPU pricing pressure. Falsifier: failed deployment or verified weak cost/token. Missing: volumes/share.

factors.name: Macro geopolitics
factors.reason: BLS Oct 14 CPI 3.7% YoY, Oct 15 PPI 6.3% YoY. BIS Jan 13 China advanced-chip case-by-case licensing conditions. Rate consensus unverified. Hypothesis: high funding costs weigh on marginal builds. Bull: disinflation; bear: costly capital/export limits. Falsifier: falling costs and continued orders. Missing: credit spreads, export exposure.

risks: CoreWeave Aug 11 $104bn backlog depends on service delivery. Sep 17 reported higher pricing for short-duration compute capacity, which does not eliminate funding risk.
TrendForce Oct 19 forecasts optical-fiber shortage from data center buildout; not evidence of AI project ROI.
SOXX Oct 19 bounce unconfirmed as sustained reversal; last 3/7 terminal signal dated Oct 15.
invalidation: Require confirmed hardware order changes to establish demand contraction.
Require observed memory pricing and point-in-time EPS history; keep prior forecast null probabilities and missing baselines.
No prospective outcome-scoring record of qualitative forecasting effectiveness.
